tools.name: search_jobs
tools.description: Search current, open job vacancies in the Turks and Caicos Islands, newest first. All filters are optional. Each result links to its tcijobfinder.com page, which links to the official advert to apply.

tools.name: get_job
tools.description: Get the full details of one current job by its slug (from search_jobs). Includes the job page link, which links to the official advert to apply.

tools.name: list_employers
tools.description: List employers with current vacancies in the Turks and Caicos Islands, with their number of open jobs and a link to their jobs on tcijobfinder.com.

tools.name: hiring_report_stats
tools.description: Headline figures from the monthly Turks and Caicos Hiring Report on tcijobfinder.com: open jobs, employers, Government vs private share, jobs by island and industry, top employers and salary disclosure, with a link to the full report. Defaults to the latest report.
